review_candidates.title: IT Systems Engineer - Voleon Securities
review_candidates.description_excerpt: You will own the systems VSec runs on, from identity, email and collaboration to compliance capture, telephony and trading-desk endpoints, within Voleon's shared Corp-IT stack, and you will build and maintain the boundaries that keep VSec a distinct entity for its clients and regulators. Responsibilities Own and operate VSec's systems in Voleon's Corp-IT stack (Microsoft 365/Entra ID, Slack, Zoom, RingCentral, ThetaLake, Atlassian, 1Password, Jamf/Intune), with runbooks documenting each VSec con
eligibility_evidence: Your colleagues will include internationally recognized experts in artificial intelligence and machine learning research as well as highly experienced finance and technology professionals.

Applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other factors prohibited by local, state, or federal law.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: AI coding assistants are welcome tools here Run end-to-end vendor onboarding for VSec tools: NDA, MSA, InfoSec due diligence under broker-dealer requirements, deployment, SSO/SCIM, and documentation Maintain compliance capture: email journaling, chat, voice and SMS archiving into ThetaLake, telephony retention settings, and evidence for Compliance and auditors Support trading desk endpoints and applications: Windows Bloomberg workstations, Linux-based trading and VNC systems, trader phones, Tradeweb, MarketAxess, TruMid, and related vendor escalations Administer and optimize VSec's shared SaaS platforms (Microsoft 365/Entra ID, Slack, Zoom, Atlassian, MDMs) and implement security best practices with the Security team. Monitor platform health, troubleshoot complex issues, coordinate vendor escalations, and lead evaluations of new solutions Partner with VSec leadership, Compliance, Securit
